summary: The buffered OpenRouter Responses path now derives terminal type and completion state from completed, incomplete, and failed statuses, with coverage for telemetry and terminal callbacks.

evidence: src/provider/openrouter-handlers.ts maps payload.status to response.completed, response.incomplete, or response.failed and passes completion only for response.completed.
src/openai-telemetry.ts forwards the derived completion flag to terminal usage accounting.
tests/openrouter-serving.test.ts covers all three statuses and verifies telemetry and callback completion state.
